title: Exception report request
description: What the report agent is given: the triage, the drafts, the approval decision and what was written.

drafts.description: The reminders drafted (the drafts shape); none when no reminder was due.

approval.description: The approval decision ({decision, by, note}); null when none was asked for.

drafts_held_back.description: Order ids whose reminder was not written because its recipient is not on the customer record.

notes_held_back.description: Order ids whose note was not written because the order is not in the ledger.

finance_written.description: Order ids that got a finance (ledger) note; empty when none ran.

warehouse_written.description: Order ids that got a warehouse note; empty when none ran.
